Class MetricDescriptor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.MetricDescriptor
public class MetricDescriptor extends Object
Descriptor defining metadata, spatial extractors (2D), and spatial aggregators (1D) for a single physical, demographic, economic, or cliodynamic metric.
